name: Modnera Fashion — Luxury Women's Ethnic & Contemporary Couture
description: Official flagship storefront of Modnera Fashion, founded by The Armaan in 2016. Discover artisanal Ethnic Wear, Dupatta Sets, Hand Work Embroidery Dresses, Kurti/Pant sets, Bottom Wear, and Frocks crafted in our Mumbai Bandra (400051) factory and Bhauwara Madhubani (847212) boutique.
